sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 251908 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: RV NONELECTRIC $20 a night in the 2026, 2027 and 2028 rate tables. The table's $30 RV ELECTRIC rate belongs to the one electric site, which is the camp host's and not bookable.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251908/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: RV NONELECTRIC $20, RV ELECTRIC $30) + campsite catalog (site 001 'Host' and 020 MANAGEMENT not reservable; 002-019 RV NONELECTRIC reservable) + facility description ('1 electric(host) and 18 nonelectric campsites'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 251908 (all 18 reservable sites 002-019 RV NONELECTRIC with 'Water Hookup'; the only electric site is the host's) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251908 (amenities: 'Water Hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 18 public back-in sites, Max Vehicle Length 40-60 ft (most 45-55), plus the camp host's site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/wright-lake ('The campground includes 18 campsites') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 251908 (Driveway Entry Back-in, Max Vehicle Length 40-60 at sites 002-019), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/wright-lake ('bathhouse includes flush toilets and hot showers'; amenities 'Dump station', 'Showers with hot water', 'Toilets (flush)') + recreation.gov facility amenities ('Dump Station'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/wright-lake ('Open seasonally October 1 - May 31') + recreation.gov notice ('Closed during the summer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations close 2 days before arrival; 14 days in any rolling 30. Pay on site with recreation.gov Scan & Pay (QR codes on the kiosk).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251908 (facility_rules: maxStay 14 days 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 2 'day(s) prior to arrival'; the 2-night minConsecutiveStay rule ended 2020-12-31) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/wright-lake ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS campground near Sumatra on a ridge in the Apalachicola savannahs, beside spring-fed Wright Lake (day-use swimming beach, 4.6-mile trail around the lake). --Claude
summary: Confirmed season Oct 1-May 31, showers/flush toilets, no electric, reservable on rec.gov. Changed fees $20-30 -> $20 (the $30 electric rate is the host's site), sites 19 -> 18 public; added water hookups at every site, max 60 ft back-ins, dump, 14-night max, 2-day cutoff. Not stated: fcfs, booking window (inherited). Potable water left: the USFS page says both 'Drinking water' and 'Potable water is not available'.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the agency describes 'a campground in a beautiful forest setting along one portion of the lakeshore' and 'Picnic tables and grills are scattered among trees with views of the lake' (fs.usda.gov and recreation.gov); entry is 'not waterfront'.
Missing phone: 850-643-2282 (fs.usda.gov Wright Lake page and recreation.gov facility_phone).
